notes.title: Added localization to the game
notes.content:
Shinobi Match now has localization in the following languages:
- English
- Portuguese
- Traditional Chinese
- Spanish
- German
- Japanese
- French
- Italian

Language is loaded by default from the language on the steam client, or can also be set manually from the game settings tab.
